question: Should bearer-authenticated WebVNC Portal sessions be accepted as part of this External desktop credential PR?
rationale: This distinct ticket, cookie, ACL, revocation, and outer-routing contract was added after prior review; source inspection looks fail-closed, but accepting the permanent security and product boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Bearer Bootstrap
options.body: Move the bearer Portal viewer flow to a focused PR and retain the narrower External credential and routing work here.

options.title: Approve Combined Scope
options.body: Keep both contracts in this PR after conflict resolution, exact-head validation, and real endpoint proof.

options.title: Pause Expanded Branch
options.body: Pause or close this branch if the combined provider and Portal security surface is no longer a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Split Bearer Bootstrap
